queer_characters.name: Alike ("Lee")
queer_characters.notes: Central protagonist whose self-acceptance as a butch lesbian is the emotional core of the narrative; ends on an empowered note choosing college and self over running away.

queer_characters.name: Laura
queer_characters.notes: Described as Alike's 'openly lesbian friend' who supports her through her journey.

queer_characters.name: Bina
queer_characters.notes: Love interest who shares a romantic encounter with Alike but denies being 'really gay-gay,' framing it as 'playful indulgence'; her rejection of the label complicates her representation.
queer_characters.contest_notes: The source text states Bina has a romantic encounter with Alike but explicitly denies a lesbian identity, so whether she is queer or experimenting is left ambiguous.

contributor_notes: Director/writer Dee Rees expanded this from her 2007 short; the source article provides no personal identity information for her, so she is not tagged as a queer creator despite the strong own-voices reputation of the film — a maintainer should verify. Bina's identity is deliberately left contested per the source. Trigger warnings for the mother's violent rejection are inferred from 'viciously attacks'; confirm whether to classify as child-abuse and/or domestic-abuse. Ending appears hopeful but is not unambiguously a 'happy-ending,' so that tag was omitted pending review.
